about_the_game:
Murder at Ironwood Inn released on August 15!

Join Our Community!

We're excited for you to try Murder at Ironwood Inn! To stay updated, share feedback, and chat with fellow players, please join our Discord server.

Game Summary:

A shocking murder shatters the quiet morning of the Ironwood Inn, a secluded bed and breakfast. The innkeeper calls you in to investigate the crime. With only 12 hours before the guests leave, you must crack the Case of the Poisoned Coffee Cup or the Case of the Bloody Candlestick before time runs out.

Play as one of four detectives, each with their own set of interrogation styles that influence the answers you'll get from suspects. Search the inn for hidden clues and earn points as you fill your Detective’s Notebook with valuable information to consider. The deeper you dig, the more secrets you’ll uncover. Everyone’s hiding something, but who should you accuse of murder?

This cozy mystery features an intricate narrative which includes multiple subplots and charming top down 2D pixel art for a truly immersive experience. The game strikes a perfect balance between suspense and relaxation, offering a truly engaging escape.

Key Features:

  • Choose your case – Pick from two different 45-minute mysteries, each with its own twists and challenges.

  • Play your way – Choose from four unique detectives, each with their own interrogation styles.

  • Interrogate suspects – Question the innkeeper and six guests to uncover their secrets through different dialogue approaches.

  • Investigate the inn – Search rooms and gather clues to build your case.

  • Track evidence – Use the Detective’s Notebook to track clues for each suspect and connect the dots.

  • Accuse with evidence – Make an accusation and attempt to get a confession, but be sure you have the evidence to back it up.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 2nd Generation Intel Core HD Graphics (2000/3000) 512MB
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
